newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Inland Steel Industries Inc Q2 net up.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Inland Steel Industries Inc Q2 net up.

text.p: NOTE: Q2 1997 income applicable to common stock $37.8 million vs $16.9 million.
Q2 1997 results include $15.9 million gain on sale of assets.
Q2 1996 results include $31.4 million gain from issuance of subsidiary stock and $14.5 million loss on early retirement of debt.
Excluding items in both periods, Q2 1997 operating income $31.1 million or $0.59 a share vs $14.2 million or $0.25.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Six-month 1997 income applicable to common stock $66.7 million vs $32.0 million.
Six-month 1997 results include gain from sale of assets of $17.9 million, or $10.0 million or $0.20 a share after-tax.

Six-month 1996 results include $31.4 million gain from issuance of subsidiary stock and $14.5 million loss on retirement of debt. On an after-tax basis, the net gain in the year-go period was $5.0 million or $0.10 a share.
